purpose: Prototype whole-reader census: every catalogue and sweep sentence of every held law checked against the stored extent reading by an independent mention-finder (no RefList, Parts, Forms, Units).
steps: from backend/: mix run data/experiments/cv-s05d-whole-reader-census/run-01/dump.exs input.jsonl  (ReadCache, warm: ~1 min; 3,358 laws)
/usr/bin/python3 census.py input.jsonl out  (~2 min; parses each law's CLML for its structure)
/usr/bin/python3 bench.py input.jsonl > out/bench.txt  (recall: rounds 9-12 agent NEW)
from backend/: mix run .../verify.exs and verify2.exs  (Extent.of on the found defects)

inputs.input.jsonl: dump.exs output: per law default, application, lists, applies, catalogue sentences + sweep uncaught (with SweepForm)

outputs.out/sentences.tsv: every sentence (3,560): class, worst verdict, counted/silent, flags
outputs.out/unnamed.tsv: stored positive refs no statement of their place names (516 refs, 83 laws)

notes: Scripts were tuned for precision against sampled false flags during the run; bench held at 10/10 after each change. Effect-id scan: 0.
